text:
OptiHealth (customer): Hey team — since last night's model rollout to rwd-2.5 we're seeing the model confidently state incorrect clinical guidance (not minor wording changes, full-on made-up dosages and invented drug interactions). This started ~02:15 UTC after the deploy. Examples below, this is urgent for our product.
sarah-cs: Sorry to hear that. Can you paste a couple of concrete examples + the exact API request you used? Also which endpoint (chat vs completions) and model name?
OptiHealth (customer): Pasting two short repros. We call the chat endpoint, model: rwd-2.5-highperf, temperature=0.2. Previous pinned model rwd-2.4 had no issues. Response excerpt: ```
User: "Our patient is on med A. Is it safe to take med B simultaneously?"
Model: "Yes — med B increases clearance of med A; reduce med A dosage to 50% and monitor LFTs weekly."
```
This is wrong — med B doesn't interact with med A in any literature we can find. Also another sample: ```
Prompt: "What is the recommended adult dose for Somnaxal?"
Model: "The standard adult dose is 150 mg twice daily."
```
Somnaxal is not a real drug — model is inventing names and dosages.
mona: Thanks for the examples. Can you paste the raw curl request (headers + body) and the response tokenization if possible? Also are you using any post-processing or result-filtering on your side?
OptiHealth (customer): Here's the minimal repro curl we used:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"rwd-2.5-highperf","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a clinical assistant. Answer concisely."},{"role":"user","content":"What is the recommended adult dose for Somnaxal?"}],"temperature":0.2,"max_tokens":200}'
```
Response body (truncated): ```
{"id":"chatcmpl-xyz","object":"chat.completion","choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"The standard adult dose for Somnaxal is 150 mg twice daily. Monitor renal function every 2 weeks."}}]}
```
ravi: Noted. Deploy bot shows rollout tag rwd-2.5 rolled to 100% at 2026-11-05T02:00Z. No config change logged in customer routing. Are you on Hosted or Dedicated?
OptiHealth (customer): Hosted. We did not change our prompts. This is reproducible in our staging and prod.
oncall-bot: deploy rwd-2.5 to production by ci/infra at 2026-11-05T02:00Z — rollout 100% — user: eng-release
alex-ml: Thanks for the repro; can you confirm whether rwd-2.4 returns a different (and correct) response against the same prompt? If possible, include model outputs from both versions side-by-side.
OptiHealth (customer): Yes — rwd-2.4 returns: "I could not find reliable dosing information for Somnaxal; consult formularies or a clinician." So older model is conservative.
sarah-cs: This sounds like a factuality/regression where the newer model is more assertive. Quick workaround: pin your integration to rwd-2.4 or set safety hooks to filter invented entities. We'll open a support ticket and escalate.
alex-ml: Assigning to eng-ml for triage. Initial hypotheses: decoder/LM head calibration change, or dataset/finetune mix that increased hallucination propensity. Also check any recent ranking/penalty changes for hallucination suppression.
mona: OptiHealth shared conversation id: chatcmpl-xyz and request id: req-7750. Also included server logs showing identical latency and no request truncation.
alex-ml: Good — can you also share the token-level log (deterministic sampling seed if any) and the full response with logprobs? We'll need that to see where the model's confidence spikes.
OptiHealth (customer): Attached logprobs in a separate upload. They show extremely high probability on the invented tokens.
ravi: Setting internal priority P1. Are there any customer-impacting billing or auth issues? Not at the moment — just output quality.
alex-ml: For immediate mitigation, we'll push a soft rollback to rwd-2.4 for hosted customers using the conservative safety profile while we investigate. Can support confirm any customers should be excluded from rollback?
sarah-cs: I'll email the account team. OptiHealth requests rollback for their workspace only — they cannot risk more incorrect clinical claims.
OptiHealth (customer): Appreciate that. ETA?
alex-ml: We aim for targeted rollback within 2 hours, then deeper root-cause once we have token logs analyzed. Next steps: 1) engineering to pull model diffs and recent checkpoints; 2) run batch eval against our clinical prompt suite to reproduce; 3) decide fix (recalibrate decoder vs retrain).
mona: Filed INC-9001 and linked logs + customer artifact.
alex-ml: Thanks. I'll ping when we have the rollback scheduled and results from the reproducibility test. Meanwhile, please avoid using the model for live clinical decisioning.
OptiHealth (customer): Understood — switching to rwd-2.4 for now. Thank you for quick response. :pray:
